query: Create a line chart to analyze the trend of 'Tax Rate %' over the 'Tax Year'.
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(df['Tax Year'], df['Tax Rate %'], marker='o')
plt.title('Trend of Tax Rate % Over Tax Years')
plt.xlabel('Tax Year')
plt.ylabel('Tax Rate %')
plt.grid(True)
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Tax Year', 'y_fields': ['Tax Rate %'], 'chart_type': 'lineChart'}
plt.show()

query: Generate a bar chart to compare the 'Slope' values across different 'Tax Years'.

query: Generate a combo chart to visualize 'Tax Rate %' and 'Slope' over 'Tax Year'.
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
ax1.bar(df['Tax Year'], df['Tax Rate %'], color='lightblue', label='Tax Rate %')
ax1.set_xlabel('Tax Year')
ax1.set_ylabel('Tax Rate %', color='blue')
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(df['Tax Year'], df['Slope'], color='red', marker='o', label='Slope')
ax2.set_ylabel('Slope', color='red')
plt.title('Tax Rate % and Slope Over Tax Years')
fig.tight_layout()
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Tax Year', 'y_fields': ['Tax Rate %', 'Slope'], 'chart_type': 'comboChart'}
plt.show()

query: Create a stacked bar chart to show the distribution of 'Tax Rate %' and 'Factor' over 'Tax Year'.
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(df['Tax Year'], df['Tax Rate %'], label='Tax Rate %', color='lightcoral')
plt.bar(df['Tax Year'], df['Factor'], bottom=df['Tax Rate %'], label='Factor', color='lightgreen')
plt.title('Stacked Bar Chart of Tax Rate % and Factor Over Tax Years')
plt.xlabel('Tax Year')
plt.ylabel('Values')
plt.legend()
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Tax Year', 'y_fields': ['Tax Rate %', 'Factor'], 'chart_type': 'stackedBarChart'}
plt.show()
